label: House
depicts: Modern house block with one right window column and one lower doorway
use_when: Use when the interface wants a modern house block with a tall right window column.
avoid_when: Do not use for the simpler modern house when the right side should not carry stacked window dots.

label: Ice Cream
depicts: Ice cream shape with three rounded scoops above one pointed cone
use_when: Use when the interface wants an ice cream cone with scoops stacked above a pointed cone.
avoid_when: Do not use for the popsicle when the frozen treat should stay inside one rounded bar shape.

label: Ice Cream
depicts: Popsicle bar with two inner stripes above one short stick
use_when: Use when the interface wants a popsicle or frozen bar with a stick below the rounded top.
avoid_when: Do not use for the ice cream cone when the treat should break into scoop shapes above a cone.

label: Inbox
depicts: Tray inbox with one sloped top edge and one centered front notch
use_when: Use when the interface wants an inbox tray with sloped top walls and a front notch.
avoid_when: Do not use for the rounded square inbox when the outer body should feel boxier and more even.

label: Inbox
depicts: Rounded square inbox with one centered front notch inside a box frame
use_when: Use when the interface wants an inbox shown as a rounded square box with a central notch.
avoid_when: Do not use for the tray inbox when the top walls should slope downward into the opening.
